deviation: The draft refers to an unspecified "Data Processing Agreement" that the parties "have executed, or will execute alongside this Agreement". It doesn't require the Arcadia DPA and doesn't bar processing until the DPA is signed. Personal data could be processed with no DPA, or under a vendor-form DPA, which breaks the playbook rule that the Arcadia DPA be signed before go-live. 7.2 also says "as permitted by... applicable law" instead of requiring compliance with data protection law.
suggested_text: 7.1 The Services involve the processing of Personal Data of Arcadia's customers and employees. Vertex shall execute the Arcadia Data Processing Agreement (the "DPA") before any Personal Data is processed and in any event before go-live, and the DPA is incorporated by reference. Vertex shall not process any Personal Data until the DPA has been executed by both Parties. In the event of conflict regarding Personal Data, the DPA prevails. 7.2 Vertex shall process Personal Data only on Arcadia's documented instructions and in accordance with the DPA and applicable data protection law. 7.3 Vertex shall maintain administrative, technical and physical safeguards appropriate to the risk and consistent with recognized industry standards, and shall notify Arcadia without undue delay after becoming aware of any unauthorized access to, or loss or disclosure of, Arcadia's data or Personal Data.
